summary: Full end-to-end validation of Matchipy. All 5 workflow blocs, auth (JWT httpOnly), RGPD delete, and provider integrations verified against real user routes via the public preview URL. Backend pytest suite: 10/10 passed (real Claude claude-sonnet-4-6 calls exercised on upload/analyze/generate; Affinda 401 confirmed and internal pdfplumber fallback active as designed; PDF %PDF and DOCX PK bytes verified).
ai_feature_verdicts: CV structuration (Claude via emergentintegrations) - pass - evidence: POST /api/cv/upload returned StructuredCV with identity.full_name='Camille Dupont', 2 experiences, 6 skills; frontend Bloc1 rendered fields correctly - skill: ai-testing-llm

Job offer analysis (Claude) - pass - evidence: POST /api/job/analyze returned job_title + hard_skills containing 'TypeScript','React','Node.js','PostgreSQL','Docker','AWS' from pasted French offer text - skill: ai-testing-llm

Matching + rewrite generation (Claude) - pass - evidence: POST /api/generate returned score.overall>=0, 8 missing skills surfaced in UI (missing-skills-card), 2 rewrite cards with per-bullet diffs+keyword source tags, cover_letter.paragraphs populated - skill: ai-testing-llm

ATS check (Affinda + fallback) - pass (fallback by design) - evidence: banner in UI reads 'Analyse de lisibilité interne ... Affinda a refusé la clé API (HTTP 401)'; report.score=100%, 17/17 fields read - skill: ai-testing-core (fallback is the specified behaviour, key is intentionally invalid)
critical_code_review_comments: auth._set_cookies uses samesite='none' + secure=True — correct for the cross-origin preview + Kubernetes ingress; keep it, do not weaken.

routers.get_current_user is stateless per-request (good), but login lockout keys use client.host which behind an ingress is typically the ingress IP — brute-force protection may be effectively per-email not per-IP. Not a bug for this feature set, worth noting.

Step5Export.download uses `disabled={!reviewed || downloading}`; downloading is a string ('' | 'pdf' | 'docx'), so the button is disabled whenever any download is in flight. Works, but could disable just the button currently loading (minor UX).
seed_data_creation: Test user created via /register during flow; CV records auto-cleaned by test_delete_cv and RGPD flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs against the public URL and exercises real Claude calls (~30s). Affinda 401 is EXPECTED and the internal pdfplumber fallback is the shipping behaviour — do NOT treat it as a bug. Sample CV at /tmp/sample_cv.pdf is used for upload. All 5 Blocs (Upload -> Analyze -> Generate -> ATS -> Review+Export PDF/DOCX) verified end-to-end in the real browser. Registration + JWT httpOnly cookies working; /dashboard and /workflow correctly redirect to /login when anonymous.
